title: Evening Oct 30 (late): no changes, defensive with two breakout shorts
journal:
Book ~$541 (0.99x vs. $547.60). Last 3 hours: no losses beyond small moves on the two 55/20 breakout shorts (ETH short −$0.25, SOL short about −$1 as SOL bounced to $96). No rule did harm: the brain bought nothing in a slow bear market (SOL $96 vs. its 20-day average $103.5, BTC 5% below its average, 2 of 19 large memes above theirs) and the news radar opened nothing because there was no new shock with price confirmation. No code changes.

The breakout shorts stay on their system rules (exit at the 20-day high: ETH $2,578, SOL $113.39). Devil's advocate: SOL is bouncing and the Binance-hack selling may be exhausted; a squeeze toward the 20-day high would cost about 1% of the book per position, which is the risk the system accepts.

All five funded user stools carry the same ETH and SOL shorts (checked on-chain today). No new picks: no dated catalyst with a verifiable Solana token turned up, and the screener only shows euphoric or storyless tokens. Cash stays in USDC.
